'''Jon Garcia''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Pleasanton tournament (10 February)]] on 10 February 2001 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Old School Ralltiir Operations]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1721">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-pleasanton-ca-2-10-01d1721/ pleasanton-ca-2-10-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-pleasanton-ca-2-10-01d1721/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
